verse.verse_1: I CALL THIS earth to witness --
verse.verse_2: And you are free to live upon it, --
verse.verse_3: And the parent and the offspring,
verse.verse_4: That We created man in toil and trouble.
verse.verse_5: Does he think that no one has power over him?
verse.verse_6: He says: "I have wasted a great deal of wealth."
verse.verse_7: Does he think that no one sees him?
verse.verse_8: Did We not give him two eyes,
verse.verse_10: And showed him two highways (of good and evil)?
verse.verse_11: But he could not scale the steep ascent.
verse.verse_12: How will you comprehend what the Steep ascent is? --
verse.verse_13: To free a neck (from the burden of debt or slavery),
verse.verse_14: Or to feed in times of famine
verse.verse_17: And to be of those who believe, and urge upon one another to persevere, and urge upon each other to be kind.
verse.verse_18: They are the people of the right hand (and will succeed).
verse.verse_19: But those who deny Our revelations are the people of the left hand:
verse.verse_20: The Fire will vault them over.
